layers.name: Discovery and provenance
layers.contract: Untrusted catalog records + rights/lineage; no executable quote.

layers.name: Coherent market state
layers.contract: Generation, block/slot/object versions, available_at, commitment, completeness, checkpoint.

layers.name: Exact transformation models
layers.contract: Typed consumed/residual/output vector + state transition + obligations; exact only for pinned admitted model.

layers.name: Rights, credit, aliases
layers.contract: Shared balances/collateral/allowance/nonce and required check boundaries; no implicit unlimited budgets.

layers.name: Bounded search and sizing
layers.contract: Finite exact candidates and sampled capacities; no linear quote extrapolation.

layers.name: User obligations and allocation
layers.contract: Per-user limits/deadlines; original owner wrappers need concrete algorithm extension.

layers.name: Replay and verification service
layers.contract: Reproducible capsule, semantic checks, full service costs; validity != optimality.

layers.name: Mechanisms and competitive response
layers.contract: Rule comparison, behavioural assumptions, null/negative results and no-subsidy demand.

layers.name: Non-atomic lifecycle
layers.contract: Claims, partial fills, settlement/restart evidence; not a transaction sender.

note: Conceptual extension through canonical owners, not an implemented parallel graph/solver schema.
